jobs.description:
Highlights:

• Full-Stack Python/TS engineer needed for a B2B SaaS startup in Copenhagen (with plenty of traction!)

• We have a lean, get-stuff-done team. No annoying extra management layers or unnecessary bureaucratic rituals. And we are "AI-forward" in our own development practices.

• You will own features end to end, from the data model through to the screen, on a platform that manufacturers rely on to keep production lines running.

• You will work in a small engineering team, directly with the person who decides what we build, and the problems you spend your time on are hard because the domain is hard, not because the organization is.

• We're building legitimately useful tools for the industries and companies that make the world go around.... manufacturers. Both AI-tools and just "plain-old-good-software" tools.

About Supplios

Manufacturers live or die by their supply base. Sourcing the wrong supplier, onboarding one slowly, failing to qualify one properly or losing track of a non-conformance can stop a production line and cost millions. Yet most manufacturers still run these relationships across email chains, spreadsheets and shared drives.

Supplios is a supplier collaboration platform for manufacturers in automotive and industrial sectors. We cover the full supplier relationship: sourcing, onboarding, qualification, day-to-day collaboration, compliance and supplier quality, all in a modern cloud based platform that is easy for manufacturers to implement and operate. It is built specifically for the way automotive and industrial manufacturers actually work.

We are headquartered in central Copenhagen and already serve customers globally in our vertical, including some of the most demanding names in automotive. We have grown to this point almost entirely on product strength, domain credibility and word of mouth.

The platform now covers more ground than the team that built it. We are hiring engineers to keep that pace sustainable, and to go deeper on the parts of the product our customers are pushing hardest.

The role

You will join a small engineering team and work across the whole stack: Python on the backend, TypeScript on the frontend and in the AI layers. There is no split between people who design and people who implement. You will take a problem from a customer conversation or a product decision through to something running in production for real manufacturers.

You will work directly with our co-founder and CEO, who is a hands-on product builder himself. That means short conversations instead of tickets thrown over a wall, and it means your questions about why something should work a certain way get answered by the person who decided it.

The domain is genuinely complicated, and that is the interesting part. Supplier relationships in automotive involve deep hierarchies, long-running approval processes, strict audit requirements and a lot of state that has to be exactly right. Modeling that well is most of the job.

Title and level flex with experience. We are open to strong mid-level engineers and to senior engineers who want more scope than their current company gives them.

We work together from our office in central Copenhagen. This is primarily an in-office role: at this stage, and on a codebase with this much implicit context, working through problems with the rest of the team in person is much faster than doing it in writing. Sensible flexibility when you need it is a given; full-time remote is not what we are offering.

Our current stack:

• Backend: Python / Django

• Frontend: Vue (but no specific Vue experience is needed)

• Infrastructure: AWS (mostly)

• Agents: Cloudflare (TypeScript) + Claude & OpenAI platform

What you will do

• Build features end to end, from data model and backend logic through to the TypeScript frontend our customers actually click on.

• Build end-to-end / front-to-back AI features (in-app AI assistants, background worker agents, email-routing agents, customer-configurable agent framework components)

• Design and evolve the relational data model that sits under supplier relationships, approvals and quality records.

• Take vaguely defined customer problems and turn them into something specific enough to build, then build it.

• Work on integrations between Supplios and customer systems (ERP and adjacent tooling), where failures have visible consequences for a production line.

• Improve the parts of the codebase that need it, rather than routing around them.

• Review other people's code and have yours reviewed; we keep the loop tight and unbureaucratic.

• Help keep the platform healthy in production across our regions: errors, performance and the boring things that keep customers trusting us.

• Take part in product decisions. Engineers here are expected to have opinions about what we build, not just how.

What we are looking for

Essential

• Professional experience with Python. This is not negotiable; the backend is Python and you need to be effective in it.

• Solid TypeScript experience and genuine comfort working on the frontend.

• Experience building and running SaaS products, including the part after launch where real users depend on them.

• AI-forward development techniques. (This does not mean you no longer write code.)

• A track record of owning work end to end without waiting to be told what to do next.

• The temperament for a small, senior company: high ownership, low ceremony.

• You want to work primarily from an office in central Copenhagen, with a small team.

Nice to have

Genuinely a plus, not a requirement. Nobody has all of these.

• Experience with B2B enterprise SaaS, especially where customers are large and demanding and implementations are not self-serve. This is a significant plus.

• Experience with complex relational data modeling, and with large, long-lived codebases that you did not write yourself. A big plus.

• Experience building AI-based products, using the latest frameworks/harnesses and infrastructure components (including RAG) is a significant plus.

• Familiarity with any of: domain-driven design, the actor model, finite state machines, CQRS, event-driven architecture. We use these ideas where they earn their place, and it helps if the vocabulary is already yours.

• Startup experience, particularly early stage. A significant plus.

• Knowledge of manufacturing, automotive or supply chain. Useful, but we can teach you the domain; we cannot teach you the craft, so do not rule yourself out on this.

Language

English is the only important language for this position; we work in English, and so do our customers. Danish language skills are not required.

Why this role is worth your time

• The scope is unusually large for the stage. You are one of a small number of engineers on a platform that serves demanding customers globally. What you build ships, and it ships soon.

• No layers between you and the decisions. You work directly with the co-founder and CEO, who runs product. There is no committee to navigate and nobody to translate your work for you.

• Hard problems that are not artificially hard. The complexity comes from the domain (hierarchies, state, audit trails, integrations that must not fail), not from organisational overhead.

• Real customers already, and real gaps. The product has paying customers in automotive and clear places where it needs to get better. Both halves of that are true, and both are why this is a good job.

How to apply

Send your CV and a short note on why this role interests you to team@supplios.com. Work examples will help.

Apply by email

Send an email to team@supplios.com

Please include your CV / resume, and a brief note about why you're interested in the position.

Thanks!

Shape your future with confidence.

• Product and technology diligence

• Assessment of the product portfolio and roadmap, together with the underlying technology and R&D setup to evaluate commercial attractiveness/value creation potential

• IT diligence

• Evaluating the IT environments, from strategy to costs, to identify risks and opportunities, and to inform the investment case

• Technology integration and separation

Your main responsibilities:

Lead and contribute to a variety of pre- and post-deal engagements, including product and tech due diligence, digital value creation as well as managing workstreams as part of integrations or carve-outs

•

•

• 
Act as a role model and support development of junior team members, coupled with the recruitment and training responsibilities

What we look for

You value collaboration and bring an inclusive approach, building strong relationships with both clients and colleagues. • 
Accelerate your leadership journey by joining as a senior leader within the team, leveraging your transformative leadership skills externally and internally

• 
Broaden your horizons by working on highly integrated teams across the globe and collaborate with people of diverse backgrounds — both professionally and culturally

• 
Embrace flexibility with EY's hybrid work model, empowering you to find the right balance of in-office and client site collaboration with the convenience of remote work

• Interview process will include two case interviews as well as an interview on personal fit to the team

Please submit your application no later than 1 December 2026. Selection and interviews are ongoing. If you have any questions or need more information about the role, please contact Malthe Pedersen at malthe.t.pedersen@parthenon.ey.com. For questions regarding the recruitment process, contact Jakob Damsted at Jakob.Damsted@dk.ey.com.

Exploring the software from a user perspective and identifying areas that can be improved

• 
Assisting with documenting findings and communicating observations to developers and product teams

• 
Supporting the maintenance of test documentation and quality-related processes

• 
Participating in team meetings and collaborating with colleagues across development and product teams

• 
Contributing to quality initiatives that help us continuously improve our products

You will gain hands-on experience with software development processes, quality assurance practices, defect reporting, and modern collaboration tools used in professional product development environments.

Job requirements

Who We Are Looking For

We imagine that you:

• 
Are currently enrolled in a higher education program

• 
Have an interest in software, technology, or digital products

• 
Enjoy learning new systems and tools

• 
Are structured and pay attention to details

• 
Like collaborating with others and communicating your observations clearly

• 
Take responsibility for your tasks and are comfortable working independently when needed

• 
Have good English communication skills, both written and spoken

Most importantly, you are curious, motivated to learn, and enjoy understanding how things work.

It Is a Plus If You Have Experience With

Don't worry if you don't tick all the boxes. These are simply nice-to-have skills that you can also learn while working with us:

• 
Basic understanding of websites, web applications, or software development

• 
Experience working with technical tools or systems

• 
Interest in software testing, quality assurance, or product quality

• 
Familiarity with Azure DevOps or similar collaboration tools

What We Offer

At Trackman, you will join a team of passionate colleagues who are eager to share their knowledge and help you grow professionally.

We offer:

• 
Practical experience within software quality assurance and product development

• 
Mentorship and support from experienced QA professionals

• 
Insight into how innovative software products are developed and maintained

• 
A flexible student position that works alongside your studies

• 
A modern workplace with excellent facilities at our headquarters in Hørsholm

• 
Great colleagues, social activities, and plenty of opportunities to learn and develop

The position is expected to be 15-20 hours per week, with flexibility around exams and study commitments. The role is primarily based at our office in Hørsholm.

The Office

We are located at DTU Science Park in Hørsholm. We take great pride in the state-of-art building we have designed! The office features bright meeting rooms, coffee areas to catch up with colleagues, a large testing arena with simulators available for employees and a fitness center, everything surrounded by a beautiful forest and respecting the environment. We made sure to utilize the newest technologies to be energy efficient and be mindful of ventilation and sound propagation. The cherry on top is our canteen: with an indoor and outdoor area to enjoy the fresh food prepared by our own kitchen staff.

Join the home of a powerful sports brand and a one-of-a-kind technology

Our proprietary technology is based on expert knowledge about radar, computer vision, data, and software engineering. Our solutions are developed by specialists who endlessly explore and challenge new technical boundaries. Trackman’s blend of cutting-edge technology, sports, and continued growth make our company an outstanding place to work.

Our work culture is entrepreneurial, ambitious, and rewarding as you get to collaborate with inspiring colleagues and interact with the leaders of golf, baseball, and football. Based on a unique brand reputation, we are proud to work in close partnership with the top athletes, organizations, and teams that rely on our technology to stay ahead of the race.

We are a Danish company founded, owned, and managed since 2003 by three entrepreneurs with a strong passion for sports. Today, we have a global footprint with our headquarters located in Denmark (Hørsholm) and offices in New York, Phoenix, Seoul and Tokyo. We employ over 1000+ people worldwide, half of which work in Denmark, where most hardware and software products are developed, tested, and manufactured.

Where innovation happens

At Trackman, we know that great people make great products. We believe that teams thrive, and innovation sparks in an atmosphere where people are encouraged to think for themselves, where everybody’s voices are heard, and where the best ideas prevail in the pursuit of exceptional solutions. This mix makes Trackman an inspiring company – for our customers and colleagues.

Share our Passion!

Applications are continuously assessed, so please send your application as soon as possible.

jobs.occupation: Are you our new digital marketing & content creation intern?
jobs.description:
We are looking for a digital marketing & content creation intern to help us with marketing and branding.

longvé is a dynamic and innovative jewellery start-up located in the heart of Copenhagen, near Kongens Nytorv. We offer a fresh digital approach to the jewellery industry, with our digital platform empowering customers to design their own jewellery. We offer the customers classic customisable designs, handcrafted quality and sustainable sourcing of recycled materials, all at a transparent and fair price. The company launched at the end of 2022.

We are currently seeking an digital marketing/content creator intern. This is a unique opportunity to impact a newly launched brand, and get a steep learning curve, while working in a high-paced start-up environment, where we make sure to have fun.

Besides being enrolled in a study program within marketing, social media, content production, creative or multimedia design, the ideal candidate should have:

• Ambitions within digital marketing and content production

• A sublime eye for detail and aesthetics

• Experience with using the Adobe suite (experience within other platforms such as Lightroom is also a benefit)

• A passion for editing work and acknowledge that the details are super important

• A team player mindset and appreciate getting constructive feedback

• Excellent writing skills in both Danish and English (fluent in English)

• The ability to be self-leading and take ownership of own tasks

What you will do:

• Produce content (videos and photos) for organic use across social media

• Be part of planning the campaigns and come up with creative ideas for content

• Create graphic material for social content, social ads and other digital channels

• Editing photos and videos from photoshoots

• Support in planning and coordinating photoshoots

• Assist with social media management and execution

• Assist with setting up content for email campaigns and programs

• Ad-hoc marketing tasks

What you get:

• Hands-on experience with building and activating a new digital brand

• Insights into and experience with the start-up world

• Possibility to build up portfolio material

• Autonomous working schedule where you can influence ways of working

• Working closely with the founders and joining a team that values great energy, good humour and strong collaboration

The start date and length of the internship will be agreed with the selected candidate. The internship may lead to a potential job opportunity based on the fit, skills, and growth of the business.

We promise to give you hands-on experience as well as an exciting playground for you to test, develop and execute great ideas. If you find this an exciting opportunity, please send your CV and resume, with some examples you have done, and the style you like personally. Send to Katja Schjølin at katja@longve.com.

Gubra is a science-enabled biotech company advancing peptide-based drug discovery, development and preclinical research, driven by impact for patients, planet and people. If you are a pragmatic, collaborative lawyer who wants to use your legal expertise to help us succeed in a fast-paced fun environment, you will thrive with us.

The opportunity

As Gubra continues to grow, so does the breadth and complexity of the legal and compliance matters supporting our business. We are therefore looking for a Legal Counsel to join our Legal team and work across Gubra's CRO Services, Biotech, Ventures and group functions.

Gubra operates at the intersection of scientific research, drug discovery and development, and commercial partnerships. Our activities span Biotech, Ventures and Business Development, Gubra Green, CRO Services, enabled by specialist corporate functions, in an entrepreneurial environment of around 330 employees.

Reporting to the Group General Counsel, you will have a broad role spanning commercial contracting, healthcare compliance, corporate governance and general legal advice. You will work closely with colleagues across the organization, translating legal requirements into pragmatic solutions that enable the business to move forward while managing risk appropriately.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys combining sound legal judgement with a practical understanding of how a growing life sciences business operates.

Your role

You will act as a trusted legal partner to the business, with a particular focus on supporting Gubra's CRO Services, and Biotech discovery and development activities.

A significant part of the role will involve contracts. You will help simplify and strengthen the way we contract, including taking a leading role in templates, reviews and legal contracting support for CRO Services. You will also draft, review and negotiate agreements across Biotech and our group functions.

Beyond contracting, you will advise colleagues on a broad range of legal and compliance matters across the product lifecycle and help our functions build legal and compliance by design into their processes from the outset.

You will work across professional disciplines and therefore need to understand both the legal or compliance issue at hand and the commercial, scientific or operational context around it.

How you will create impact

• Lead legal drafting, review and negotiation as primary contracting support for our CRO Services business, including the development and maintenance of practical contract templates, playbooks and review processes and related legal technology opportunities.

• Draft, review and negotiate a broad range of commercial agreements, including vendor, clinical trial, CRO/CDMO, IT, intercompany, confidentiality and consultancy agreements.

• Advise on legal and healthcare compliance matters across the biotech discovery and development lifecycle, including anti-bribery and corruption, advertising and promotion, development and regulatory matters, privacy and data protection, exclusivity and product liability.

• Partner with group functions to support the group leads to embed compliance into their activities and ways of working, including matters related to websites and digital channels, AI, cyber and information security, data protection, labour and employment, health and safety, equity incentive programms, tax and immigration, property, environment and other ESG requirements.

• Support public-company corporate governance and affiliate management, including corporate filings, Board and affiliate activities, whistleblower arrangements, disclosure requirements and insider-trading processes.

• Help develop, implement and continuously improve legal and compliance policies, communications and training programmes.

• Support the implementation and effective use of legal and compliance technology, with a focus on simplifying processes, improving visibility and increasing efficiency.

• Monitor relevant changes in laws and regulations, assess their potential impact on Gubra and help translate new requirements into practical actions across the business.

• Work closely with colleagues across the Gubra functions on matters requiring cross-functional legal input.

Your profile

We are looking for a collaborative and commercially minded risk focused lawyer who combines strong legal fundamentals with curiosity, sound judgement and a pragmatic approach to help the business act responsibly. You are comfortable working independently, and equally comfortable involving colleagues or escalating issues when the circumstances call for it.

We expect that you bring:

• Approximately 3–5 years of post-qualification legal experience, including at least 2 years of in-house experience within the pharmaceutical, medical device or biotech industry.

• Strong experience drafting, reviewing and negotiating contracts across all business areas, including agreements relevant to pharmaceutical development, biotech or CRO activities.

• A passion for helping build solutions to the business deliver in the right way and balanced risk tolerance and assessment.

• A good understanding of the legal and compliance environment applicable to life sciences companies and an ability to apply that knowledge pragmatically.

• Experience advising internal stakeholders and translating complex legal requirements into clear and actionable guidance.

• The ability to manage and deliver competing priorities, a varied workload in a fast paced environment and move comfortably between detailed contract work and broader legal, compliance and governance questions.

• A university degree in Law. Admission to the bar or equivalent qualification to practise law is an advantage.

• Ability to draft in English and Danish. Strong written and spoken Danish and English.

It is an advantage if you also bring:

• Experience advising CRO, drug discovery or drug-development contracting and related activities.

• Exposure to healthcare compliance, clinical development or pharmaceutical regulatory matters.

• Exposure to public-company governance and compliance.

• Experience implementing legal operations, contract-management or compliance technology.

• Experience working across jurisdictions in an international organisation.

Personal qualities:

• Pragmatic and commercially minded. You look for solutions that enable Gubra to embrace opportunity and to protect Gubra, while allowing the business to progress and execute in the right way.

• Curious and comfortable with complexity. You are interested in understanding the science, business and operational context behind a legal and compliance question.

• Collaborative and approachable. You build trusted relationships and enjoy working with colleagues from different professional backgrounds.

• Confident in your judgement. You can challenge constructively, explain your reasoning clearly and know when an issue needs to be escalated.

• Hands-on and accountable. You take ownership, manage priorities effectively and follow matters through to completion.

• Clear and concise communicator. You can see patterns and turn complex issues legislation and legal analysis into practical advice that non-lawyers can understand and act on.

About Gubra

Gubra is a disease-agnostic techbio company specialised in peptide-based drug discovery and development, ventures and business development and preclinical contract research services. Our activities are focused on the early stages of discovery and drug development and organised around highly synergistic business areas: Biotech, Ventures and Business Development, CRO Services, Gubra Green and Group Functions.

Our therapeutic focus includes metabolic and fibrotic diseases, while our capabilities span areas such as in vivo pharmacology, ex vivo assays, drug profiling, histology, imaging and advanced transcriptomics. Gubra's ML/AI-driven peptide drug discovery platform, streaMLine™, supports the rapid development of peptide hits towards nonclinical candidates.

Our team consists of around 330 employees, many located in Hørsholm, Denmark and others in the US, Europe, UK and Switzerland. Our working environment combines different cultures and educational backgrounds with entrepreneurial drive, scientific curiosity and teamwork.
